change_summary: Removed the large blank gap inside the AI assistant card on the full settings page, between the optional free-key card and the assistant status line.
Root cause: the grid rule that stretched cards to full height applied to every card in the settings grid, including the nested free-key card, which grew to the entire AI card height (about 1858 px).
The height rule and the card-header gap rule now apply only to the direct outer cards of the grid, so the free-key card keeps its natural content height (about 219 px).
Added normal spacing before the assistant status line so it keeps a small, even gap instead of sitting flush against the key card.

On the AI assistant page, the route badges and their test buttons no longer overflow the side card on narrow widths: the header row, the badge line and the three detail rows now wrap onto new lines instead of crossing the card boundary.

The detailed-assistant-settings link now points to /settings#ai-settings, the assistant card carries an ai-settings id with a scroll margin, and a small script re-scrolls to the section after the page renders and on enhanced navigation.
Only presentation changed; no money, data, permission or database semantics were touched.
review_findings: Build after the change: dotnet build Wizz.Presentation -c Release = 0 errors (pre-existing StyleCop warnings only).
Browser measurement on the real instance at http://localhost:5183/settings: the free-key card is now 219 px high instead of 1858 px, and the gap before the assistant status alert is 16 px.
The AI card body no longer overflows (scrollHeight equals clientHeight, 1796 px), the paired cards keep equal heights (612/612 and 293/293), and there is no horizontal page overflow.

Browser check on http://localhost:5183/ai before the fix: the badge container started at left = -5 outside the card (card left = 24) and the page scrollWidth was 1493 against a 1488 viewport; after the fix no element overflows the card, the badges move to a second line (66 px header), and there is no horizontal scrolling.

Anchor check: clicking the detailed-assistant-settings link from /ai ends at /settings#ai-settings with the assistant card 72 px from the top (scrollY = 1131); opening /settings#ai-settings directly gives the same result. No console errors were reported.

Limitation: the 286 automated tests do not cover the browser grid layout, wrapping or anchor scrolling; the evidence above is manual and was not reproduced in CI because GitHub Actions remains unavailable for the account.
Boundary note: the changes are presentation-only; money, stock and permission settings stay in the full settings page and were not altered.
Execution remains unauthorized outside the recorded limited scopes (D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31, D-32, D-33).
Phase 3 (cash drawer, purchases, UI, sync) is not implemented and not authorized.
MVP-AT-09 still requires a real restore test in a separate environment.
